title: Scout eval case
description: Eval cases for Scout, the research-and-synthesis agent. Tests quality of decision framing, NOT agreement with Mal's conclusions. A case scores well if Scout framed the decision such that Mal could decide fast and well, including surfacing options or conflicts Mal might have missed. It scores badly if Scout recommended on a central topic, fabricated, smoothed a conflict, padded, or overstepped its seat, regardless of whether its conclusions matched Mal's.

task_type.description: The kind of task Scout is run on. Research synthesis modes digest external material; platform-stewardship inspects a Drive snapshot and proposes platform fixes. Same gate and discipline rules across all modes.

material.description: the source(s) to digest; ref by path if large

brief.description: The filled brief handed alongside the material (see brief template).

golden.description: What a strong brief contains. NOT a fixed string. Required elements + a worked example, since two good briefs can differ. For Scout, the golden describes good FRAMING, not a correct answer.

should_surface.description: options, conflicts, or settling-facts a strong brief surfaces that a lazy one would miss. The highest-value thing Scout does. Scoring rewards these even when inconvenient.

must_not.description: failure modes. Any hit caps the case. The central-topic recommendation check is the hard one for research; the executes-an-operation check is the hard one for platform-stewardship (any past-tense framing of a fix being applied fails AC-1).
